title: Implement an ask command — RAG end-to-end in one function

cues.en: So, at this point, we've set up our necessary query logic and everything seems to work as it should.
cues.zh: 現在必要的查詢邏輯已建立，看起來一切都正常運作。

cues.en: And what I'd like to do this time around is to work on creating a new command over in here in cli.py.

cues.en: We have a command right now, ingest and scan and chat.
cues.zh: 目前已有 ingest、scan 和 chat。

cues.zh: 我要再建立一個 ask，它與 chat 有些不同，因為完全不保留狀態。

cues.en: So I want to be able to type a command like pyreg ask, and then in quotation marks, what is a vampire?
cues.zh: 我希望能輸入像 pyrag ask，再用引號包住「什麼是吸血鬼？」這樣的命令。

cues.en: And the goal here is to demonstrate that our entire system will work from end to end.
cues.zh: 目標是示範整套系統從頭到尾都能運作。

cues.en: So this is going to be a little bit different than chat, this command, because this one actually remembers the state of the conversation.
cues.zh: 所以它會與 chat 這個會記住對話狀態的命令不同。

cues.en: I could ask, what is a vampire, get an answer, and then say, tell me more about that.

cues.en: And it would know what that refers to because it maintains the context.

cues.en: We're not going to do that with this one.
